overrides.source: Visual and text verification of official ISC 2018-2019 remuneration PDF, page 3, on 2026-10-09
warnings: Source is an unaudited schedule with a review engagement, not an audited schedule.
The review report excludes Health Services Inc. and Child and Family Services Inc. remuneration and may omit remuneration from other reporting entities.
Source Other column is retained as other payments, separate from travel and expenses.

overrides.source: Visual and text verification of official ISC 2015-2016 remuneration PDF, page 4, on 2026-10-09
warnings: Source is an unaudited schedule with a review engagement.

Only Chief and Council honoraria, travel expenses and telephone allowances are included. Separately disclosed Nation Employee salaries and travel are retained as source disclosures and excluded from Council totals, as the source footnote instructs.
The source identifies all rows as Council Members without an individual Chief designation; no Chief title is inferred.

overrides.source: Visual and text verification of official ISC 2013-2014 remuneration PDF, page 4, on 2026-10-09
warnings: Source is an unaudited schedule. Salary and other remuneration form a subtotal; the subtotal is not an additional payment.
The source has no combined total column. Displayed totals are derived from the remuneration subtotal plus travel expenses.
The source states that travel expenses include amounts related to per capita distributions.
Bonnie Lavellee has explicit dash/zero payment cells and remains a source-listed Council member.
